QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Undiscovered Wilds
QuestInfo.0: Ask Eremos where your next training location is.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos has chosen a dangerous valley deep in the mountains for the next phase of your training. Because it is rife with predators as yet undisturbed by humans, he says it's a worthwhile place for a trial. Defeat 900 wolves in Ice Valley.
QuestInfo.2: Your defeat of the wolves of Ice Valley have given you a newfound faith in your strength.
